locomotion.method: Median ground-level backward foot speed over one normalized cycle; average of both feet. Camera projection converted at 30px display height. No mesh or world scaling changed.

axeVisibility.method: 4 subpixel orthographic rays per native 30px pixel; evaluated body BVH occlusion against the axe blade mesh

toolCorrection.axeHead: tapered flared wedge, 60mm socket to 12mm edge
toolCorrection.workToolBinding: Rigid hand-space calibration for dedicated Meshy clips; pick downward strike, hammer at waist, knife horizontal and broadside.
toolCorrection.knifeReadability: 100mm broadside blade, cold steel contrast, horizontal grip

knifeVisibility.method: 4 subpixel orthographic rays per native 30px pixel; evaluated body BVH occlusion against the knife blade mesh
